notes.shape: Hard negative. A model-adaptation chapter states the model's thinking default and the frequency steer, and tags the span with the guide and the section it comes from.
notes.carve_outs: Distilling-file surface applies. The attribution that accounts for the fact is the inline citation on the span: (guide, "Calibrating effort and thinking depth"). Quote that line; the carve-out needs it.
notes.rubric: Not graded. The paragraph that follows the tagged one is the chapter's own correction and states no external fact.
notes.carries: Per-span source tags are the second attribution shape the carve-out names, after a Sources section. A run that recognizes only Sources sections fails this case.
